note: Approximate Ice-Age land bridges / exposed continental shelves, hand-traced. Shown as exposed land while sea level was low; each drowns by its toYear. Indicative, not survey-accurate. Derived from Holocene sea-level / paleocoastline literature (CRC806; PaleoMIST).

properties.name: Doggerland
properties.note: A vast lowland linking Britain to mainland Europe, rich in Mesolithic life; drowned by rising seas and the Storegga tsunami (~6200 BC).

properties.name: Britain–Europe land (Channel)
properties.note: Britain was part of the continent: the English Channel and Celtic shelf were dry land until rising seas made it an island ~6500 BC.

properties.name: Beringia
properties.note: The Bering land bridge between Siberia and Alaska — the route by which people first reached the Americas; drowned ~11,000 years ago.

properties.name: Beringia (Alaskan shelf)
properties.note: The eastern half of the Bering land bridge, on the Alaskan side of today's strait.

properties.name: Sundaland
properties.note: An exposed shelf joining Malaya, Sumatra, Java and Borneo into one landmass; flooded as the ice age ended.

properties.name: Palawan land (Sunda)
properties.note: Palawan and nearby islands joined Borneo on the exposed Sunda shelf.

properties.name: Sahul (Arafura plain)
properties.note: Exposed shelf linking Australia and New Guinea across what is now the Arafura Sea and Torres Strait.

properties.name: Bassian plain (Tasmania)
properties.note: A dry plain across the Bass Strait joined Tasmania to mainland Australia until ~8,000 BC.

properties.name: Sakhalin–Japan land
properties.note: Lower seas linked Sakhalin and Hokkaido to the Asian mainland, and nearly closed the strait to Honshu.

properties.name: Persian Gulf plain
properties.note: The Gulf floor was a fertile river valley (the lower Tigris–Euphrates) before the sea flooded in ~8,000 years ago.

properties.name: Adriatic plain
properties.note: The northern Adriatic was a broad plain — an extension of the Po valley — when seas were lower.

properties.name: Aegean land (Cyclades)
properties.note: Lower seas exposed much of the Aegean shelf, merging many of today's islands into larger landmasses.

properties.name: Strait of Sicily land
properties.note: Shoals and exposed banks narrowed the gap between Sicily and Tunisia when seas were low.

properties.name: Adam's Bridge land (India–Sri Lanka)
properties.note: A land connection between India and Sri Lanka across the Palk Strait, now a chain of shoals.
